#### external-dns-helm-chart-1.22.0
Provenance: https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/external-dns/releases/tag/external-dns-helm-chart-1.22.0

Flagged (breaking/deprecation/migration keywords):
> - **Breaking:** `policy` no longer defaults to `upsert-only` and is now required. You must set `policy` explicitly to one of `create-only`, `sync`, or `upsert-only`. [#6508](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/external-dns/pull/6508) @mloiseleur
> - Update _ExternalDNS_ OCI image version to [`v0.22.0`](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/external-dns/releases/tag/v0.22.0). [#6650](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/external-dns/pull/5479) @stevehipwell
````text
### Added

- Add value `.service.enabled` to enable the creation of the Kubernetes service. [#6400](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/external-dns/pull/6400) @jullianow
- Add value `replicaCount` to set the number of `external-dns` replicas (bounded to `0` or `1`, since external-dns does not support leader election). [#6503](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/external-dns/pull/6503) @yugstar
- Add `crd` as a valid `registry` value and grant the matching RBAC on `dnsrecords` for the CRD registry. [#6513](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/external-dns/pull/6513) @mloiseleur
- Add value `hostAliases` to inject entries into the `Pod`'s `/etc/hosts`, for reaching a provider or webhook by a hostname that cluster DNS cannot resolve. [#6588](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/external-dns/pull/6588) @jetersen

### Changed

- **Breaking:** `policy` no longer defaults to `upsert-only` and is now required. You must set `policy` explicitly to one of `create-only`, `sync`, or `upsert-only`. [#6508](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/external-dns/pull/6508) @mloiseleur
- Update _ExternalDNS_ OCI image version to [`v0.22.0`](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/external-dns/releases/tag/v0.22.0). [#6650](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/external-dns/pull/5479) @stevehipwell

### Fixed

- RBAC compliance checkbox for dnsendpoints/status [#6442](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/external-dns/pull/6442) @vflaux
````


### external-dns (appVersion): 0.21.0 → 0.22.0
- Kind: inner-app (inner app of `ghcr.io/home-operations/charts-mirror/external-dns`)
- Files: `kubernetes/apps/network/external-dns/cloudflare/ocirepository.yaml`, `kubernetes/apps/network/external-dns/pihole/ocirepository.yaml`, `kubernetes/apps/network/external-dns/unifi/ocirepository.yaml`
- Upstream: https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/external-dns (resolved via Chart.yaml sources/home)
#### v0.22.0
Provenance: https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/external-dns/releases/tag/v0.22.0

Flagged (breaking/deprecation/migration keywords):
> **Action required before upgrade**
> - :warning: The default annotation prefix is now `external-dns.kubernetes.io/` with no fallback (#6424)
> - :information_source: You can either migrate your annotations or set `--annotation-prefix=external-dns.alpha.kubernetes.io/`.
> - :arrow_right: It's recommended to try this version with `--dry-run=true`, see [recommended upgrade instructions](https://kubernetes-sigs.github.io/external-dns/latest/docs/version-update-playbook/).
> - :warning: To avoid any unwanted DNS records deletion from the annotation prefix change, `--policy` is now required with no default (#6508).
> - :warning: **CRD/API upgrades**: Gateway API `TLSRoute` now uses `v1`, standard channel since Gateway API v1.5.0 (#6367). Ambassador `Host` now uses `getambassador.io/v3alpha1` (#6482). Pi-hole v5 API is removed, v6+ only (#6406).
> - :information_source: On AWS, ownership TXT records for A ALIAS now use the `a-` prefix (#6523). Migration is automatic and ownership is preserved
> - :information_source: This release removes _in-tree_ support for Akamai, Plural & Transip (#6485).
> - Users needing those providers can use a previous version of ExternalDNS or a webhook-based provider. Gandi is marked for removal (#6634).
> - :information_source: DNAME record support (#6553), and `--rfc2136-axfr` replacing the deprecated `--rfc2136-tsig-axfr` (#6598).
> - :information_source: Guide on how to safely [upgrade External-DNS](https://kubernetes-sigs.github.io/external-dns/latest/docs/version-update-playbook/)
> ## :warning: Breaking Changes
> 
> - [annotations] switch default annotations prefix to GA by @mloiseleur in #6424
> - [config] require explicit --policy flag by @mloiseleur in #6508
> - [provider/pihole] drop Pi-hole v5 API support by @ivankatliarchuk in #6406
> - [registry/txt] use a- prefix for AWS A ALIAS ownership TXT records by @mloiseleur in #6523
> - remove unmaintained providers (akamai, plural, transip) by @mloiseleur in #6485
> - [source/gateway-api] migrate TLSRoute to v1 by @ecray in #6367

````text
## General information

**Action required before upgrade**

- :warning: The default annotation prefix is now `external-dns.kubernetes.io/` with no fallback (#6424)
   - :rotating_light: This change can _delete_ **all** your DNS records. 
   - :information_source: You can either migrate your annotations or set `--annotation-prefix=external-dns.alpha.kubernetes.io/`.
   - :arrow_right: It's recommended to try this version with `--dry-run=true`, see [recommended upgrade instructions](https://kubernetes-sigs.github.io/external-dns/latest/docs/version-update-playbook/).
   - :warning: `--dry-run` is not preventing changes to happen with _ns1_ & _alibaba_ cloud providers

- :warning: To avoid any unwanted DNS records deletion from the annotation prefix change, `--policy` is now required with no default (#6508). 

**Important**

- :warning: **CRD/API upgrades**: Gateway API `TLSRoute` now uses `v1`, standard channel since Gateway API v1.5.0 (#6367). Ambassador `Host` now uses `getambassador.io/v3alpha1` (#6482). Pi-hole v5 API is removed, v6+ only (#6406).
- :information_source: On AWS, ownership TXT records for A ALIAS now use the `a-` prefix (#6523). Migration is automatic and ownership is preserved
   - Leftover `cname-` records can be cleaned with `scripts/aws-cleanup-legacy-txt-records.py --alias-cname-cleanup`.
- :information_source: This release removes _in-tree_ support for Akamai, Plural & Transip (#6485). 
   - Users needing those providers can use a previous version of ExternalDNS or a webhook-based provider. Gandi is marked for removal (#6634).
- :information_source: New: [`crd` registry](https://kubernetes-sigs.github.io/external-dns/latest/registry/crd/) as an alternative to TXT (#5372)
- :information_source: DNAME record support (#6553), and `--rfc2136-axfr` replacing the deprecated `--rfc2136-tsig-axfr` (#6598).
- :
[…truncated]
````
